data.name: Luxembourg

sources.label: Freedom House: country electoral and political indicators, 2026 edition

legitimacy.summary:
Our assessment: Luxembourg has broadly credible and competitive national electoral institutions. The latest country indicators support meaningful voter choice, sound electoral rules and an opposition able to contest governing power. This is not a guarantee that every contest is flawless, nor a judgement about the popularity of any party.

Evidence baseline: Freedom in the World 2026, covering conditions in 2025. Our review date is not the date of an observer verdict on a later ballot; subsequent contests may require a separate assessment.

data.coverageNote: Selected records only. Earlier elections and additional result detail are still being added.
